title: His mother's church and playing spirituals between services
summary: Cap's friends came to play spirituals at his mother's church for dinner, and the boys learned the songs by listening.

story.theme_name: Church, faith and religion in a musician's life
story.community_name: Church, faith and jazz: the sacred and the secular

blocks.x: I had that coffee then. You know, uh... Kid Howard, Chester Jones, so many others. Those people would have their churches. My mother had her church, too. And my mother used to ask Caps, she'd say, why don't you all come down and play at my church sometime? And, uh, we'd go down there and play. And my mother would say, uh, I'm glad you all came. She said, I'm gonna have dinner for you. She said, I have a wonderful dinner back there. I'd get my teacher out of Howard and Howard said, I haven't eaten yet. And, uh, well, the older people's cooking, you know, the way they cook, you understand? And, uh, so, Chester and Howard asked my mother, when you gonna have church again, you gonna have it tomorrow? And then, uh, you know, you wanna come back down here and eat?
